meta.title: Black Friday, {{reliability.pool_exhausted_at}}
meta.description: Watercolor of a jammed warehouse conveyor: cart events piled up faster than the cart service could clear them, until the fallback lever sent carts back to the monolith.

theme.concept: The Keystone story's warehouse: kraft paper, packing-slip ink, forest green for the way out.

steps.caption: On Black Friday 2025, cart events arrived {{reliability.incident_multiple}} faster than a normal Friday.
At {{reliability.pool_exhausted_at}} all {{reliability.incident_pool}} cart database connections were in use.
In {{reliability.incident_minutes}} of customer impact, about {{reliability.incident_carts}} carts were abandoned.
The fallback lever the migration plan kept sent cart traffic back to the monolith.
